name: Element Bender VR
summary:
ELEMENT BENDER VR puts the elements in your hands.
  Your LEFT hand commands ICE. Your RIGHT hand commands FIRE.
  Targets surge out of elemental gates in perfect sync with the music —
  extinguish fire with ice, melt ice with fire, and keep the rhythm alive.

  • Opposing-element combat: strike FIRE targets with your ice hand and ICE targets with your fire hand
  • 8 target types: element orbs, directional crystals, dual targets, rapid chains,
    hold streams, power cores, energy walls to dodge and hazard
